content.title: Hover an allocation segment to focus the matching legend item
content.intent: Prove hovering any allocation segment provides transient focus feedback by expanding the segment and highlighting the matching legend item.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning across allocation segments because the hover affordance is stated once and should behave consistently for every slice. covering_array on asset_class degraded to effective_t=1 from requested strength 2 because only one input existed, so this scenario sweeps Equities, Fixed Income, Alternatives, Cash, and Commodities as equivalent representatives. I did not split a separate center-content scenario because **gap-3** already records that the selected-allocation replacement content is underspecified. Budget ceiling=8 existed; budget_cut kept this scenario as a primary discovery path.
